• 1 1/2 pounds plantains, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice

• 1 tablespoon vegetable oil

• 1/2 cup all-purpose flour

• 2 eggs, well-beaten

• 2 cups chopped onion

• 6 cups shredded cooked skinless chicken

• 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro

• 1 lime, juiced

1.  Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.

8.  Divide the egg mixture among the plantains.

10.  Remove from heat and stir in the onion, chicken, and cilantro.
11.  Serve with lime juice.
